messages:
sophia_marketing: Quick sync: Manifold case interview tomorrow 2pm PT with CTO. Need hero quote + logo permission + legal clearance by Fri to make next-week launch and webinar. Who can own clips, transcript, and webinar copy?

eden_growth: I can own webinar promos and inbound routing (campaign=manifold-case). Need final publish URL by Mon.

maya_content: I'll do ASR + 1-pass edit and produce 3 social snippets + one 45s product highlight clip. Please drop raw audio in the shared folder after the call.

kevin_se: I'll upload raw audio and a quick markers.txt with timestamps for key quotes.

legal_team: Reminder: if the quote includes numeric improvements, we need source context or a permission line from Manifold. Send quote + context to legal-review@redwood.com. Expect ~48h.

assets-bot: Reminder: embargo placeholder set for 2026-04-20 08:00 PDT if legal clears by 2026-04-18 17:00.

sophia_marketing: Maya, please tag any metric lines with [CLAIM: check]. Kevin, capture a brief in-chat permission from Manifold for logo and partner names. Eden, draft a one-line webinar hook; keep it benefit-focused.

eden_growth: Draft hook: "How Manifold cut inference latency and scaled across teams with Redwood". Shorter version for signup will follow.

maya_content: Will add hero copy options and flag claims. Plan to post raw link here within 1 hour after interview.

kevin_se: Uploaded raw/ markers after call. File: /marketing/assets/manifold/3976543210/raw.wav, markers.txt.

legal_team: Received quote via DM from Manifold in-chat. We'll start review now and ping if we need supporting data.

sophia_marketing: Thanks team 1. If legal redacts metrics, we'll proceed with qualitative language for blog and hold webinar emails until cleared. I'll update this thread when legal sign-off complete.
